title: League of Legends Patch 26.19 Notes
overview: Patch 26.19 is the pre-Worlds warm-up: Riot buffs a batch of fringe pro picks (Aatrox, Aphelios, Elise, Kha'Zix, Lillia, Volibear) while knocking down the year's meta staples (Vi, Nocturne, Poppy, Ryze, Rumble) and nerfing Nasus's early stacking. Support starter items shift health into health regen for melee supports, and top lane gets faster Teleport cooldowns via the role quest. Arena gets a huge Augment drop plus Guests of Honor, and Classic adds Fizz, Graves, Nami, and Nautilus.
summary: Jungle meta staples take hits: Vi loses base AD and shield strength, Nocturne's Paranoia cooldown is up 20s, and Poppy's Q monster damage cap is reverted, while Elise, Kha'Zix, and Lillia get buffed back into relevance.
Nasus Q bonus damage drops by 10 at every rank, so early stacking and lane sustain are noticeably weaker — and Ryze's Q Flux bonus damage plus E mana cost both got worse.
Aphelios gets buffs across nearly every gun, Aatrox, Aurora, Draven, Fiora, and Volibear all get power back, and Lucian's Vigilance passive is gutted while his Q base damage rises.
World Atlas and Runic Compass trade flat health for health regen, favoring melee supports in extended laning, and top lane's role quest Teleport cooldowns drop by 30s.
changelogHighlights: League Classic adds Fizz, Graves, Nami, and Nautilus, plus the returning items Cloak and Dagger, Moonflair Spellblade, and Zz'Rot Portal.
Arena adds 13 new Augments (including Hellbent, Shark Bait, Surge Field, Titan's Resolve, Death Dealer, and Got That Dog In Em) and three new Guests of Honor: Ivern, Senna, and Thresh.

champions.summary: W cooldown smoothed early and E healing scaling up.
champions.details: Infernal Chains' early cooldown drops from 20s to 18s and Umbral Dash heals 1.3% per 100 bonus health instead of 1.1%, so Aatrox sustains harder in extended fights after the Sundered Sky nerfs.
champions.name: Aatrox

champions.summary: Buffs across Calibrum, Severum, Gravitum, Infernum, and Crescendum.
champions.details: Calibrum Moonshot gains 10 base damage, Severum heals more, Gravitum's slow decays to 15% instead of 10%, Duskwave's cooldown drops by 1s, and mini-chakrams start at 16% AD, making every weapon rotation stronger.
champions.name: Aphelios

champions.summary: E damage up 10 per rank and R rift lasts longer at early ranks.
champions.details: The Weirding gains 10 base damage at every rank and Between Worlds' rift now lasts 2.25s at rank 1 instead of 1.75s, improving her waveclear and giving more room to outplay with the return portal.
champions.name: Aurora

champions.summary: Base AD up from 62 to 64.
champions.details: Two extra base attack damage sharpens his early trades and axe pressure now that role quest gold income has diluted his Adoration advantage.
champions.name: Draven

champions.summary: Passive on-hit damage and W attack speed both up.
champions.details: Spider Queen deals 2 more magic damage per rank and Skittering Frenzy grants 10% more bonus attack speed at every rank, meaning faster clears and stronger spider-form damage.
champions.name: Elise

champions.summary: More health growth and a much stronger ultimate heal.
champions.details: Health growth rises to 105 and Grand Challenge's heal gains range (600), higher per-tick values, and a 350% bonus AD max scaling, rewarding her for actually landing the full execute.
champions.name: Fiora

champions.summary: Passive damage up and Evolved Leap range increased to +300.
champions.details: Unseen Threat gains 5 flat damage, Evolved W slow lasts 2.25s, and Evolved E adds 300 range instead of 200, making his weaker evolve paths actually worth taking.
champions.name: Kha'Zix

champions.summary: Base armor up and R sleep duration extended to 2.5s.
champions.details: Armor rises from 22 to 24 and Lilting Lullaby puts enemies to sleep for half a second longer, letting her survive the dives her kit demands and set up bigger plays.
champions.name: Lillia

champions.summary: Vigilance passive gutted, Q base damage raised.
champions.details: Empowered on-hit damage falls from 15 (+20% AD) to 5 (+15% AD) while Piercing Light gains 30 base damage at max rank, shifting power from bot-lane duo synergy to solo-lane Lucian.
champions.name: Lucian

champions.summary: Q cooldown refund no longer scales down with Ability Haste.
champions.details: Alpha Strike now always refunds a flat 1 second on hit, which barely matters on Summoner's Rift but is a real buff in high-haste modes like Arena and ARAM Mayhem.
champions.name: Master Yi

champions.summary: Q bonus damage down 10 at every rank.
champions.details: Siphoning Strike now deals 30/50/70/90/110 bonus damage instead of 40-120, delaying his stacking curve and cutting the lifesteal sustain he leans on in lane.
champions.name: Nasus

champions.summary: R cooldown increased by 10-20 seconds.
champions.details: Paranoia now costs 160/130/100 seconds instead of 140/115/90, meaning far fewer global dives and less frequent dueling pressure across the map.
champions.name: Nocturne

champions.summary: Q minion/monster damage cap reverted downward.
champions.details: Hammer Shock's max health damage cap on minions and monsters drops to 70/105/140/175/210, directly slowing her jungle clear and shrinking her flex-pick power.
champions.name: Poppy

champions.summary: Overheat attack speed slashed, jungle monster cap raised.
champions.details: Junkyard Titan's Overheat attack speed falls from 50-130% to 30-100% while the monster damage cap climbs to 90-175, hitting elite Rumble's fight dominance while keeping jungle Rumble clearing fine.
champions.name: Rumble

champions.summary: Q Flux bonus damage and E mana cost worsened, armor growth up.
champions.details: Overload's Flux-empowered damage bonus drops 10% at every rank and Spell Flux costs 5 more mana, while armor growth rises to 4.7 to soften bad solo queue matchups — net less burst and roam pressure.
champions.name: Ryze

champions.summary: Base AD lowered and passive shield reduced to 10% max health.
champions.details: Attack damage becomes 61 + 3.9/level instead of 63 + 3.5/level and Blast Shield drops from 12% to 10% max health, making her early clear and dive durability noticeably riskier.
champions.name: Vi

champions.summary: Passive gains AP attack speed scaling and a bonus AD damage ratio.
champions.details: The Relentless Storm now grants 4% attack speed per 100 AP per stack and its lightning on-hit adds 20% bonus AD scaling, buffing both the core AP build and the fringe AD build simultaneously.
champions.name: Volibear

items.summary: Flat health traded for health regeneration on support starters.
items.details: World Atlas and Runic Compass now give 0/60/200 health but 50%/75%/75% health regen, which favors high-base-regen melee supports who want to grind out sustained laning instead of only roaming and all-inning.
items.name: World Atlas

items.summary: Same health-to-regen shift as World Atlas.
items.details: Runic Compass loses flat health in exchange for stronger health regen scaling, rewarding melee supports who stay in lane rather than relying purely on roams.
items.name: Runic Compass

systems.summary: Top lane role quest Teleport cooldowns reduced by 30 seconds.
systems.details: The free role quest Teleport drops from 420s to 390s and the upgraded Unleashed Teleport goes from 330-240s to 300-210s (non-top Unleashed unchanged), giving top laners much more split-push and map influence.

systems.summary: High Roller drop rate reduced again.
systems.details: High Roller is now rarer in ARAM: Mayhem, cutting down on early-game snowballing from an overtuned Augment.

systems.summary: 13 new Augments, three Guests of Honor, and champion balance across Arena.
systems.details: Arena adds Augments like Hellbent, Shark Bait, Surge Field, Titan's Resolve, Rite of Ascension, Death Dealer, and Got That Dog In Em, introduces Ivern, Senna, and Thresh as Guests of Honor, raises missing-health energy regen to 400%, and retunes champions including Bel'Veth, Zed, Veigar, Sion, and Aphelios.

systems.summary: Fizz, Graves, Nami, and Nautilus join Classic alongside three revived items.
systems.details: The water-themed champion drop adds pre-rework Fizz, Graves, Nami, and Nautilus, while Cloak and Dagger, Moonflair Spellblade, and Zz'Rot Portal return from the community Council vote, plus balance swings on Fiora (nerfed), Galio, Kassadin, Akali, Shyvana (buffed), Morgana, and Twisted Fate (nerfed).
The planned expansion of voice chat to your full team in North America and Oceania has been delayed past Patch 26.20 with no target patch, so you're still stuck with pings and chat.

title: League of Legends Patch 26.18 Notes
overview: Patch 26.18 celebrates Caps' Hall of Legends induction while trimming long-standing pro-meta staples on Summoner's Rift. Nautilus, Bard, Seraphine, Syndra and Zeri get taken down a peg, Viego, Master Yi, Ekko, Kassadin and Zaahen get buffed, and Cassiopeia is rebalanced away from a laning-dominant, pro-skewed profile. League Classic adds five reworked-era Demacian-flavored champions and ARAM Mayhem cleans up its Augment pools.
summary: Nautilus and Bard finally eat nerfs — Nautilus loses base AD and Q damage, Bard's armor drops, so your tank support isn't quite the free lane bully anymore.
Seraphine's E cooldown is flattened to 11s at all ranks, gutting bot-lane Seraphine's spam, and Zeri's W loses AD scaling on both the normal and wall-hit damage.
Buff patch for Viego, Master Yi, Ekko, Kassadin and Zaahen — Viego's passive heal now scales off AD/AP/attack speed/HP, Yi gets armor growth and faster Highlander, Kassadin gets a punchier Q and R.
Cassiopeia is retuned: weaker Q/R base damage and passive move speed, but much bigger AP ratios, so she's worse in lane and scarier when fed.
Syndra's W cooldown is up 1s at all ranks and her passive mana refund is capped lower, pushing her back toward Lost Chapter builds.
changelogHighlights: League Classic adds Fiora, Galio, Poppy, Shyvana, and Xin Zhao in their old-school kits.
ARAM Mayhem Augment pools reworked with new exclusion filters so champions get more relevant Augment offers.

champions.summary: Armor base and growth reduced
champions.details: Bard's armor drops from 34 + 5/level to 32 + 4.7/level, so the roaming support who was already hard to punish now actually dies to sustained trades — stop diving him and he'll notice.
champions.name: Bard

champions.summary: Weaker base damage, much higher AP ratios
champions.details: Q damage drops 10 flat while its AP ratio goes 65%→75%, R drops 25 base but goes 50%→75% AP, E mana cost rises to 45 with its base/enhanced ratios reshuffled, and her passive move speed is trimmed — Cassio is far weaker in lane and significantly stronger once she has items.
champions.name: Cassiopeia

champions.summary: Cheaper Q with better return damage
champions.details: Q - Timewinder costs 10 less mana at every rank and its return damage AP ratio goes 60%→70%, giving mid-lane Ekko more sustained poke and clear without touching his Hail of Blades burst pattern.
champions.name: Ekko

champions.summary: Stronger Q ratio and early Riftwalk damage
champions.details: Null Sphere's AP ratio rises 70%→80% and Riftwalk base damage goes 70/90/110 to 80/95/110, giving Kassadin more early-mid agency instead of purely praying for level 16.
champions.name: Kassadin

champions.summary: More armor growth and faster Highlander
champions.details: Armor growth goes 4.5→5 per level and Highlander move speed rises to 40/50/60%, partially compensating him for the earlier Guinsoo's Rageblade bugfix and making his dives stick better.
champions.name: Master Yi

champions.summary: Base AD and Q damage cut
champions.details: Base AD drops 61→58 and Dredge Line's damage at higher ranks falls to 85/125/165/205/245, so the year-long meta king trades less well in lane while keeping his CC lockdown identity.
champions.name: Nautilus

champions.summary: E cooldown flattened to 11s at all ranks
champions.details: Beat Drop no longer scales its cooldown down with rank (was 11 to 9s, now flat 11s), which is a direct hit to bot-lane Seraphine who maxes E early while barely touching the support build.
champions.name: Seraphine

champions.summary: W cooldown up, passive mana refund lowered
champions.details: Force of Will's cooldown rises by 1s at every rank and her passive splinter mana caps at 199 instead of 255, cutting into her solo-queue W damage share and forcing more mana investment like Lost Chapter.
champions.name: Syndra

champions.summary: AD growth up and passive heal now scales
champions.details: Attack damage growth goes 3.5→4 and Sovereign's Domination's heal now explicitly scales with bonus AD, AP, bonus attack speed, and bonus HP, making both his standard and bruiser builds noticeably tankier in extended fights.
champions.name: Viego

champions.summary: Q2 damage nearly doubled plus resurrection QoL
champions.details: Q2 base damage jumps to 30/60/90/120/150 and Q now goes on cooldown immediately when he enters resurrection (or Guardian Angel / Zilean R), so he no longer wakes up with a dead Q.
champions.name: Zaahen

champions.summary: W loses AD scaling on both hits
champions.details: Ultrashock Laser's AD ratio drops from 120% to 100% total AD and its wall-hit version from 180% to 150%, pulling power out of Zeri's burst and waveclear before she becomes fully meta-dominant.
champions.name: Zeri

items.details: Guinsoo's Rageblade stacks now persist 4s instead of 3s, compensating on-hit carries for the earlier double-hit bugfix and making it easier to keep stacks up between targets.
items.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade

systems.summary: Five old-school champions join League Classic
systems.details: Fiora (2012-2015), Galio (2010-2017), Poppy (2010-2015, complete with untouchable Diplomatic Immunity), Shyvana (2011-2013) and Xin Zhao (2012-2017) are added in their historical kits, alongside Anivia and Warwick/Nasus nerfs and Gangplank, Heimerdinger and Kayle buffs.

A new exclusion pool and a "Not AP Ratio-less" filter stop AP Augments like ADAPt, escAPADe and Phenomenal Evil from appearing on AD-only champions, Clown College is re-enabled, Spin to Win's R damage bonus goes 30%→50%, and Hydra augment abuse cases are patched.

systems.summary: First Classic Council poll results announced
systems.details: Player votes will bring Zz'Rot Portal, Cloak and Dagger and Moonflair Spellblade back to Classic, add always-visible modern jungle timers, and put a turtle in top river and a duck in bottom river in an upcoming patch.

systems.summary: Baron and Serpent's Fang bugs fixed
systems.details: Baron Nashor's max Void Corruption stacks were higher than intended and Serpent's Fang's Shield Reaver damage was incorrectly applying omnivamp — both are fixed, so anti-shield builds and late Baron fights behave as advertised.

title: League of Legends Patch 26.17 Notes
overview: Patch 26.17 gives top lane a breather by nerfing Nasus and Vayne, hands melee AD carries (Irelia, Yasuo, Yone, Qiyana) real late-game scaling instead of snowball-or-lose, and trims the jungle/mid overperformers Xerath, Nocturne, and Graves. Sundered Sky takes a second nerf pass while Stormrazor gets a small buff, plus big League Classic, ARAM Mayhem, and Arena update rounds.
summary: Yasuo and Yone's crit damage penalty is halved (-10% ⇒ -5%), so early crit builds and late-game scaling both get noticeably stronger.
Vayne gets hit hard for top lane: Q Tumble now costs up to 46 mana at rank 1 and W Silver Bolts true damage drops to 4% at rank 1, while Nasus loses passive lifesteal (24% ⇒ 20% max).
Xerath, Nocturne, Graves, and Thresh all take nerfs after overperforming, with Graves losing big bonus AD ratios on Q.
Sundered Sky is nerfed again (400 HP, 40 AD) while Stormrazor climbs to 25% attack speed.
changelogHighlights: ARAM: Mayhem adds new fighter Augments Ultra Hydra and Upgrade Death's Dance; Double Tap moves to Prismatic and Upgrade Infinity Edge loses its crit chance.
League Classic adds Champion and Role swapping in Champion Select plus the first in-client Council vote.

champions.summary: Q mana cost down and W cooldown improved at higher ranks.
champions.details: Breath of Light costs 5 less mana per second at every rank and Astral Flight's cooldown drops to 14s at rank 5 (from 16s), making W the clear second max and letting you reposition far more freely.
champions.name: Aurelion Sol

champions.summary: E - Vorpal Spikes gains 10 base damage per rank.
champions.details: Vorpal Spikes now deals 30-110 base damage per hit instead of 20-100, restoring some of the early trading power Cho'Gath lost to Hail of Blades and Hextech Rocketbelt nerfs.
champions.name: Cho'Gath

champions.summary: Q - End of the Line loses 10% bonus AD on both hits.
champions.details: Initial damage drops to 55% bonus AD and return damage to 45-105% bonus AD, so high-AD Graves builds snowball games less violently out of the jungle.
champions.name: Graves

champions.summary: Q AD ratio up to 80%, plus R and W AP ratio buffs.
champions.details: Bladesurge now scales at 80% AD (from 70%) so Irelia actually threatens as a fed carry, and R Vanguard's Edge standardizes to 100% AP with W damage reduction at 8% per 100 AP for ARAM/Arena builds.
champions.name: Irelia

champions.summary: Attack speed ratio normalized, W and Mimic W AP ratios up to 90%.
champions.details: Her attack speed ratio jumps from 0.4 to 0.625 (with slower growth) while Distortion and Mimic: Distortion gain 10% AP scaling, pushing her back toward pure AP assassination builds.
champions.name: LeBlanc

champions.summary: Passive lifesteal cut to 10/15/20%.
champions.details: Soul Eater lifesteal drops by 2-4% per rank, meaning Nasus top can no longer sustain through lane nearly as freely off minions while stacking Q.
champions.name: Nasus

champions.summary: Base armor and health reduced.
champions.details: Armor falls 38 ⇒ 36 and health 655 ⇒ 640, adding real risk to Nocturne's early jungle clear and skirmishes before he unlocks his ult.
champions.name: Nocturne

champions.summary: Q damage up but monster damage modifier down.
champions.details: Elemental Wrath gains 10 base damage and 5% bonus AD scaling while its monster modifier drops to 160%, deliberately steering her power back to mid lane and away from jungle.
champions.name: Qiyana

champions.summary: E - Flay damage reduced by 10 base and 10% AP.
champions.details: Flay now deals 65-245 (+60% AP), a quiet trim to a support who's been climbing in both winrate and playrate.
champions.name: Thresh

champions.summary: W - Frozen Domain attack speed up to 110% at max rank.
champions.details: Frozen Domain now grants 30/50/70/90/110% attack speed instead of maxing at 90%, giving Trundle far more personal damage inside his own zone.
champions.name: Trundle

champions.summary: Q now costs escalating mana and W true damage gutted at early ranks.
champions.details: Tumble costs 46 mana at rank 1 (scaling down to 30) and Silver Bolts' true damage starts at 4% max HP with lower minimum damage, plus flatter health and attack speed growth — a targeted hit on Vayne top that still stings in lane anywhere.
champions.name: Vayne

champions.summary: Base health and Q damage reduced.
champions.details: Health drops 596 ⇒ 575 and Arcanopulse loses 5 base damage per rank, a light tap on a mid laner with a very high ban rate.
champions.name: Xerath

champions.summary: Crit damage penalty halved from -10% to -5%.
champions.details: Way of the Wanderer now only reduces crit damage by 5%, which rewards early Infinity Edge-style crit builds over Blade of the Ruined King and gives Yasuo a genuine scaling curve.
champions.name: Yasuo

champions.summary: Crit damage penalty halved from -10% to -5%.
champions.details: Way of the Hunter's crit penalty drops to 5%, giving Yone the same crit-build payoff as Yasuo so he doesn't have to snowball to matter.
champions.name: Yone

items.details: Stormrazor now gives 25% attack speed instead of 20%, an attempt to make it a real option again for crit and on-hit marksmen.
items.name: Stormrazor

items.details: Sundered Sky drops to 400 health and 40 attack damage after last patch's nerf landed under target, so bruisers relying on it lose both durability and damage.
items.name: Sundered Sky

systems.summary: Two new fighter Augments and ADC Augment nerfs.
systems.details: ARAM: Mayhem adds Ultra Hydra (quest for Ravenous, Profane, and Titanic Hydra) and Upgrade Death's Dance, while Critical Missile caps at 3 missiles, Double Tap becomes Prismatic, and Upgrade Infinity Edge loses its crit chance.

systems.summary: Outlier tuning plus many Arena Mods removed.
systems.details: Ambessa and Zaahen lose damage, Zilean and Vel'Koz ults get longer cooldowns, while Garen, K'Sante, Kled, Tahm Kench, LeBlanc, Senna, and Teemo get buffs; Lord Dominik's Regards jumps to 45 AD, enchanter items are normalized to 10% heal/shield power, and Spectral Cutlass no longer double-dips Lethality.

systems.summary: Arena balance patches move to odd-numbered patches only.
systems.details: Arena is shifting back to an alternating schedule so builds and discoveries aren't balanced away as quickly.

systems.summary: Doubled IP and XP gains, cheaper runes, and two free Rune Pages.
systems.details: League Classic hands everyone 2 extra Rune Pages, more than doubles IP per game, doubles Classic XP, and cuts Quintessence cost to 1000 and minor runes to 500, dramatically speeding up rune access.

systems.summary: Champion and Role swapping added to Classic Champion Select, plus the first Council vote.
systems.details: Classic players can now request champion swaps and swap pick order during the Loadout phase, and the in-client Council vote goes live with voting power earned by playing.

systems.summary: About 20 Classic balance changes hitting the strongest and weakest picks.
systems.details: Ahri, Blitzcrank, Evelynn, Ezreal, Gragas, Tristana, Tryndamere, and Twitch all take nerfs (Tryndamere's max crit chance drops 50% ⇒ 30%) while Annie, Ashe, Dr. Mundo, Garen, Kayle, Lux, Miss Fortune, and Sivir get buffs and several major bugfixes.

systems.summary: Summoner's Rift art and lighting pulled closer to the original.
systems.details: Classic's Rift gets restored foliage and decals, updated map details, and reworked spawn and torch lighting for a more authentic old-Rift look.
